Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can. You can't hatch a Digi-Egg card, however.
Card Q&A.q: One of my level 5 or higher Digimon with a digivolution card is deleted. Can I suspend this Tamer and gain 1 memory with this card's [All Turns] effect even if my breeding area isn't empty?

Effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 Digimon card among them to the hand. Trash the rest.
[All Turns] When any of your level 5 or higher Digimon with digivolution cards are deleted, this Tamer may suspend. If it did, gain 1 memory and hatch in your breeding area.
Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
